svg.title: A recorded change brings affected decisions back to the agent
svg.desc: A schematic dependency graph contains one changed assumption, highlighted amber. Deterministic local checks follow its recorded connections in blue while unrelated nodes fade. Decisions A, B and C are brought to a software agent for review. A prominent badge reads: A check that takes an agent 10 seconds runs locally in 4.5 milliseconds. This is a possible comparison, not measured timing. A changed premise does not automatically refute a decision.

text.tspan: A check that takes an agent

svg.text: When a recorded assumption changes, deterministic checks
show the agent which decisions need another look.
